heading: Tonight
text: Becoming mostly cloudy. A good chance of rain showers developing overnight, mainly north of Route 4. Lows in the 40s to near 50. Light south wind, gusting to 20 mph along Lake Champlain.

heading: Monday
text: Mostly cloudy north, with rain showers, becoming scattered in the afternoon. A mix of sun and clouds south. Cool. Highs in the 50s north, 60s south. Wind turning northwest at 10 to 15 mph, gusting 20 to 25 mph.

heading: Monday Night
text: Mostly clear with a few clouds sticking around in the north. Cool. Lows in the 30s, near 30 in the cold spots.
